tasks.prompt: Edit gepa_task/main.cpp. Replace the root-computed blur schedule with a correct fast CPU schedule. Use one parallel region at the output, vectorize the stride-1 axis with the target's natural float vector width, and place blur_y and blur_x so their storage survives across inner output rows while their computation occurs per inner row. Preserve algorithm results.

A float output has x as its stride-1 dimension and dimensions 4096x2160. Its loop nest is serial y outside serial x. Choose values for JSON fields schedule.parallel_axis (x or y), schedule.vector_axis (x or y), and schedule.vector_width (fixed_8, fixed_16, or natural_vector_size_float). Include any rationale in a separate rationale string.

A 2D GPU output is tiled into xo, yo, xi, yi. Choose JSON fields mapping.xo, mapping.yo, mapping.xi, and mapping.yi from gpu_block, gpu_thread, serial, and vectorized. Use conventional spatial GPU tiling with outer tiles assigned to blocks and inner tile coordinates assigned to threads.

A scan update is f(x) = f(x - 1) + input(x) over increasing x. Choose JSON fields legality.parallel_x and legality.vectorize_x as booleans, and reason from loop_carried_dependency or independent_iterations.

The hot vector store in a .stmt file writes output[x*height + y] while x is the SIMD lane and y is constant. Choose JSON fields diagnosis.access (unit_stride or strided), diagnosis.primary_fix (vectorize_y, reorder_storage_x_innermost, or increase_unroll), and diagnosis.verify_with (stmt_ramp or wall_clock_only). The logical x dimension should remain SIMD.

A pure Func reads an unbounded input without a boundary condition, and x has a runtime extent not known to be a multiple of the SIMD factor. Choose JSON fields tail.round_up_safe (boolean) and tail.preferred from RoundUp, ShiftInwards, GuardWithIf. Prefer the normal pure-stage strategy that avoids out-of-bounds overshoot.

Edit gepa_task/main.cpp to add a target-aware CPU schedule. Split y into fixed-size strips, parallelize the outer strip, vectorize stride-1 x using the natural int vector width, and avoid a root-sized allocation for the cheap pointwise gain Func. Preserve correctness for the non-multiple extents in the test.

A histogram update performs hist(input(r.x)) += 1, so different iterations may target the same bin. Choose JSON fields update.vectorize_r (boolean), update.parallelize_r_without_rfactor (boolean), and update.hazard from scatter_collision, unit_stride, or redundant_recompute.

A profile shows three parallel regions separated by barriers, two root-computed intermediates totaling 24 MB, recompute=1.00, and one final output. Choose JSON fields diagnosis.primary from insufficient_threads, root_pipeline_shape, or excessive_recompute; diagnosis.next_change from pull_producers_into_output, add_more_parallel_regions, or compute_everything_root; and diagnosis.expected_parallel_regions as an integer.

A tiled GPU consumer reuses a producer footprint within each block. Choose JSON fields producer.compute_scope from root, consumer_block, or consumer_thread; producer.inner_mapping from gpu_threads, gpu_blocks, or serial_only; and producer.memory_goal from shared_per_block, global_full_image, or private_per_lane.

A Func is declared f(x, y), uses the default storage order, and is consumed row-major. Choose JSON fields vector.axis from x or y, vector.access from unit_stride or gather, and storage.change_needed as a boolean.

A multi-level pyramid stage feeds many output tiles. Computing the whole pyramid independently inside every tiny vector loop causes a very high recompute multiplier. Choose JSON fields diagnosis.problem from recompute_explosion, lack_of_simd, or gpu_race; placement.direction from move_outward or move_inward; and placement.first_baseline from compute_root or compute_inline.
